appCommitNote: perf/m2-full-dataset at the generator-fidelity commit; the app image was built from a scratch clone of that commit by `perf/run.sh all` (run.json of the run: gitCommit, appImageId sha256:7d3d629039cb…); the perf tooling of this baseline (k6 scenarios, compare tool, run.sh all/baseline) was uncommitted at measurement time and changes no server code

dataset.slice: every feature (users, teams, careers, periods, reviews, 1:1s, goals, feedbacks, notifications, pulse, team KPIs, days off, impact log, succession, shares, career/days-off/account events)
dataset.snapshot: perf/snapshots/lettuce-perf-v2-2026-10-01-s1-x1.0.dump (258 MB, git-ignored); every run starts from perf/run.sh restore (and the mixed run from a fresh restore)
dataset.rows: perf/results/seed-2.json (users 522, one_on_one_meetings 132600, action items 429868, goals 30600, feedbacks 30660, pulse_responses 59749, team_kpi_values 77123, days_off_requests 12378, document_shares 11416, account_events 59392, notifications 91812 kept of 1339081 minted); verify.sql: all 92 checks passed
dataset.generatorNote: after the 2026-10-04 fidelity fixes (acd9d3ed): timestamps spread/jittered dataset-wide (SPREAD_DAYS 30, sub-minute jitter), DATASET_VERSION stays 2 — numbers measured before that reseed are not comparable

machine.cpu: Apple M5 Max (18 cores, 128 GB host)
machine.vm: 18 CPUs, 16 GB (shared by every container, including k6)

app.retentionPins: ACTIVITY_ACCOUNT_RETENTION_DAYS=0, NOTIFICATION_RETENTION_DAYS=0 (the real-clock purges are off on the perf stack)

postgres.observerOverheadNote: auto_explain.log_analyze=on instruments EVERY statement (row counting + buffer usage; per-node timing is off via log_timing=off) and pg_stat_statements + track_io_timing add a little per call, so absolute database milliseconds are inflated slightly; statement and transaction counts are exact and unaffected. No statement of any window exceeded 50 ms (max_exec 7.2 ms), so every auto_explain file was empty (not committed).

scenario.name: perf/run.sh all
scenario.oneVu: 3 iterations per (scenario, persona) after an unrecorded warm-up (2 iterations per scenario over every persona; 3 for reviews-team-view); a pgss window around each run; every iteration is a cold screen load (no client cache); each screen load of a persona's list runs once per iteration
scenario.fiftyVu: reviews-team-view: mixed 3m, ceo-all 2m, director-all/lead/hr 1m (closed loop, no think time); login storm: 50 VUs ramped over 30s, held 1m; mixed-50vu: ramp 0->50 over 2m, hold 5m, think 3-8s, 3252 iterations, database restored before it
scenario.extra: saturation-docker-stats.txt: docker stats of the app and PostgreSQL every ~4 s during mixed-50vu
scenario.knownNotClean: login.mixed.vu50: 5 of 695 sign-ins answered 429 (failed rate 0.72 %) — see FINDINGS; every other run: 0 failed requests, 0 responses without Server-Timing
scenario.summaries: reduced to the metrics scripts/perf_compare.py reads (screen_*, req_wall_ms, req_stmt, req_tx, chain_*, write_*, http_*, checks); no setup_data/tokens (the JWT-prefix grep over perf/baselines is empty)

caveat: OrbStack on one laptop is not production: compare milliseconds relatively, statement/transaction counts exactly. Baselines compare only within one datasetVersion.
